p.s: The main point of cars is the more and more a problem in our days, it implies socials and economics statements, that are contested by ecological fact.
Even though cars pollute, I tend to disagree with the statment given by the subject:" In twenty years there will be fewer cars in use than there are today."
I will give three main reason why I think there will be more cars in twenty years from now.
First of all in twenty years, the Earth 's population, will tend to be almost nine billion of people, wich is a overpopulation of course, so I think the more people there are the more cars there are.
To continue, people usually prefer to take a car than to walk, now we can say that some of them will take public facilities, but after all, a bus, is only a big car...
Whereas others facilities, are not really develloped in all contries, and people usually prefer going in a private car rather than in a common facillity.
Last but not least, the more reaserch are done to find a clean car, a car wich does'nr pollute at all, by using elctricity and even solar sistems.
As long as we have clean cars, and a very large number of person, few reasons will last in contrasting the supperiority of Car.
So, we can say after this explaination, that there wo n't be fewer cars in twenty years from now, but instead, more cars, and even more efficient cars.
